title: Add a unified Core2 flash/cache handoff timeline and reconcile code/document state

execution.environment: macOS arm64, Python 3.13.15, Node 22.14.0, QEMU 9.2.2 virtual Core2

checks.name: unified_handoff_trace
checks.detail: Cross-core, DPORT, SSI, UART and TIMG events share virtual time, CPU and guest-PC fields.

checks.name: normal_wdt_feed_gap
checks.detail: Two normal-WDT runs placed TG1 stage-0 timeout exactly 800000000 ns after the last feed.

checks.name: wdt_disabled_trace_control
checks.detail: sample=1024 and trace-off serial output were identical 507-byte banner-only logs.

checks.name: pc_sampling_control
checks.detail: The control kept the same 800 ms gap but perturbed scheduling; CPU0 UART ISR and CPU1 VM PCs are candidates, not root cause.

checks.name: uart_storm
checks.detail: No UART register event occurred in the final 800 ms window.

checks.name: core2_uiflow2_device_group
checks.detail: 6/6 cases and 24/24 checks passed without retry.

checks.name: full_uiflow2_matrix
checks.detail: 67/67 cases and 274/274 checks passed without retry.

checks.name: legacy_normal_watchdog_boot
checks.detail: The same legacy firmware reset with reset PC 0, a black frame and no non-empty application frame.

checks.name: patch_predecessor_round_trip
checks.detail: 0037 reverse, forward and reverse checks passed on the 0036 predecessor file state.

checks.name: raw_upstream_patch_apply
checks.detail: 0037 and later numbered patches are predecessor-bound; 0003 already contains later PCM state and is not a complete raw-upstream bootstrap.

notes: The trace closes the missing-timeline prerequisite but does not close RUNTIME-03.
The PC symbolization uses a local ELF not proven byte-identical to the public BIN.
The high-frequency PC sampler changes scheduling and remains disabled by default.
WDT disable, bulk-read bypass and accelerator overrides are diagnostics, not product behavior.
All functional results are virtual-device validation, not physical RF, electrical or hardware validation.
The retained dirty QEMU target tree must not be reset or cleaned.
The patch series is historical provenance, not a validated raw-upstream clean-room bootstrap.
